integrity: The critical generator identities were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Same-object 2017 and 2018 full texts were inspected directly; noncoverage claims are limited to the material actually read.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures; it does not classify noncompact invariant measures or assert Nosé–Hoover ergodicity.
The conditional identities are stationary measure laws, not pointwise first integrals for positive parameter.
The 1986 source was inspected at abstract and public author-upload metadata level rather than line by line.
The 2004 analytical Sprott-flow paper was available only through indexed metadata/classification during this comparison.
Targeted database and literature searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older statements.
title: Exact conditional-temperature and radial covariance laws in the Sprott A/Nosé–Hoover flow
